decision.title: Error records and diagnostics hold borrowed views

body.p: (task 0.5). sxml_diagnostic (description + sxml_source_location: source name, line, column in codepoints, byte offset) receives details of any failure. sxml_error_record adds the error code (sxml_error_code: namespace URI, local name, display prefix) and the error value (const sxml_sequence *, forward-declared in status.h; xdm.h in task 0.7 must define struct sxml_sequence). Together they carry what an XQuery catch clause binds: $err:code, $err:description, $err:value, $err:module, $err:line-number, $err:column-number.

item.p: All text is borrowed views: static text for errors sxml raises itself (so the common case allocates nothing), or memory owned by the object that raised the error (fn:error with a computed description or value). They are valid until that object is next used or finalized. No fixed-capacity description buffer: it would put a frozen size into the ABI and truncate.
SXML_STATUS_STATIC_ERROR, _DYNAMIC_ERROR, _TYPE_ERROR mean "details in the error record" (sxml_status_has_error_record); every other status is a condition of the C interface.
Amended by : computed descriptions and values are kept by the item heap, which a native function body can reach, rather than by "the object that raised the error", which a body does not have.
